entries.work: Grouped hotel reviews by what guests discussed and whether their comments were positive or negative.
entries.output: Ten review-based groups to help hotel teams compare guest feedback.

entries.work: Analyzed how young consumers balanced price, driving range and charging time when choosing an electric car.
entries.output: Two buyer groups and estimates of how much extra they would pay for different features.

entries.work: Co-authored a study of how a virtual creator and the product message relate to young consumers’ willingness to buy.
entries.output: A published Springer chapter on how audiences respond to virtual creators.

entries.work: Co-authored a study of students’ nutrition knowledge, physical activity and reported food choices.
entries.output: A comparison of what students knew about food and how that related to their reported diets.

entries.work: Compared how people valued travel restrictions and support when considering a move away from petrol motorbikes.
entries.output: Estimates of which policy features people favored or disliked in the choice tasks.

entries.work: Compared which service complaints went with lower hotel ratings and which positive comments went with higher ratings.
entries.output: A comparison of service failures to prevent and improvements worth investigating.

entries.work: Organized themes from hotel reviews into examples of guest needs and possible service responses.
entries.output: Three example guest profiles and questions for a future study.

entries.work: Examined a survey model of what encourages people to engage with content and keep using a platform.
entries.output: A research model linking content experience, engagement and the intention to return.

entries.work: Compared how menu order affected the amount people planned to eat and their choice of a higher-priced buffet option.
entries.output: A comparison of planned calorie intake and higher-priced buffet choices under different menu orders.

entries.work: Outlined how feeling that work is mine or ours may relate to commitment and teamwork.
entries.output: A plan for future research, rather than results from a new university survey.

entries.work: Examined how what people valued in a workshop related to their view of it and their intention to join.
entries.output: Findings about learning value and questions for improving beginner workshop support.
